mechanism_findings.identifiability: The macro-hold gauge exactly reconstructed the additive action and avoided router clipping in all nine paired cells.
mechanism_findings.reward: The five-percent held-out reward floor passed five of nine cells, including all three Hopper cells but only one cell in each of HalfCheetah and Walker2d.
mechanism_findings.frequency_alignment: Lower-LF and joint-merit reduction passed six of nine cells, but the absolute upper-HF budget passed only four. Two cells passed every gate and no environment reached the required two-of-three replicate gate.
mechanism_findings.failure_mode: A piecewise-constant upper responsibility creates boundary steps measured by HPF8 and cannot represent within-macro slow evolution. This was catastrophic in HalfCheetah, where the median lower-LF and joint merits were worse than the candidate latent split.
mechanism_findings.decision: Do not expand the constant-hold mechanism. Replace the hold with a continuous causal macro-plan curve whose parameters are fixed only at upper decision boundaries, preserving exact additive execution while separating decision rate from generated-action rate.
